summary: include_vars options: depth, dir (role vars/ or playbook-relative), extensions, file, files_matching regex, free-form, hash_behaviour replace or merge, and ignore_files.
questions: How do I merge dictionaries when loading var files?
How do I only load YAML files matching a pattern?
Where does include_vars look for relative paths in a role?
How do I limit recursion when loading a vars directory?
Which file extensions does include_vars read by default?

answer_card.title: include_vars parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `file` / `dir`: relative paths look in role `vars/` or relative to playbook
- `depth` (0 = unlimited)
- `extensions` (json, yaml, yml)
- `files_matching`: regex filter; `ignore_files`: list to skip
- `hash_behaviour`: `replace` or `merge` (applies to the whole call, not per file)
